name: Mace of Terror

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Terror
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute, fleeing you.

summary: 3 charges: a wave of terror makes creatures within 30 ft save (Wis DC 15) or flee in fear for 1 minute.
text: Terror Wave (1 charge): As a Magic action while holding the mace, you send out a pulse of dread. Any creatures you choose within 30 feet make a Wisdom saving throw against DC 15 or are Frightened for 1 minute. A creature Frightened this way can't take Reactions and must use its turns to get as far from you as possible; its only action options are Dash or trying to break free of something stopping its movement, or Dodge if there is nowhere to go. Each time one of its turns ends, it repeats the save, shaking off the effect on a success. The mace holds 3 charges and recovers 1d3 of them each dawn.
